claimScope: The tested independent-recruiter journey from one intentionally supplied relationship source to one governed next move and observed outcome.

studyDesign.material: synthetic or purpose-approved and de-identified only
studyDesign.sampleRule: Complete an a priori power analysis for the paired time ratio before enrollment and use the larger of twenty participants or the powered sample.
studyDesign.order: balanced randomized order with the same scenario objective and no design rationale shown
studyDesign.exclusions: Predeclare technical-failure and protocol-deviation exclusions; retain all safety errors and blocker cases regardless of exclusion from timing analysis.

blockedClasses: unsupported or stale fact presented as confirmed
unauthorized, duplicate, wrong-target, or falsely successful effect
privacy, access, retention, or deletion failure
safetyRule.nonInferiority: Identity, evidence, and effect error rates must be no worse than either comparator, and every observed blocker is an automatic failure regardless of aggregate metrics.

clauses.passCondition: All three conditions have frozen build or protocol identities, the same scenario objectives, and inspectable raw outcome evidence.
No active safety, privacy, identity, unauthorized-effect, prohibited-assessment, or inaccessible-decision veto exists.
Against each comparator, the median paired Talent Signal time ratio is at most 0.80 and the upper bound of a participant-clustered 95 percent bootstrap interval is below 1.00.
Against each comparator, the median paired Talent Signal time-to-verified-state ratio is at most 0.80 and the upper bound of a participant-clustered 95 percent bootstrap interval is below 1.00.
The lower bound of the 95 percent confidence interval for Talent Signal minus each comparator's verified-completion rate is above minus five percentage points.

Repeated typing, mandatory choices, wrong destinations, corrections, and abandonment are each no worse than both comparators, and at least one preregistered burden count has a median reduction of at least 20 percent against both.
At least 70 percent prefer to reuse Talent Signal against each comparator and the exact 95 percent binomial lower bound exceeds 50 percent.
The frozen release candidate satisfies the same speed, completion, burden, and zero-blocker rules against the current Talent Signal baseline.

decisionRule: Talent Signal wins only if every overall clause passes against both Ailoha and manual fallback and against the current Talent Signal baseline. Missing comparator access, insufficient power, missing destination observation, or an unresolved veto yields no_claim, not a partial win.
failureDisposition: If the rule fails, publish the bounded negative result and open one discriminating Goal for the failed construct; do not rewrite thresholds after results are opened.
